_comment: Tracked parts for the opti hypervisor rebuild (see homelab/hosts/opti/proxmox-migration.md). target_price = buy-window threshold that raises a homelab-db finding. eBay is NOT trackable from opti: ebay.com 403s server-side fetchers on TLS fingerprint (urllib AND curl, verified 2026-08-24) — same lesson as hltv, only full Chromium passes. eBay items would need the official Browse API (OAuth). RAM and NVMe are the 2025-26 spiked categories the tracker exists for; the used-eBay RAM floor (~$120 for 2x16 3200) is watched manually.
